use_case_name: Enter and Validate a Treatment Claim

claims.content: To enter and validate a treatment claim into the system, ensuring all mandatory information is complete before acceptance.

goal.raw_text: To enter and validate a treatment claim into the system, ensuring all mandatory information is complete before acceptance.

claims.content: MSIU Field Office User
The VSP staff should get the thump impression from the patient and should stick the voucher slip on the claim form.
The user should enter the information exactly into the system from the manual claim form.
The MSIU Field Office User receives a completed manual claim form with voucher slip and thumb impression from the VSP staff and initiates entry of the claim into the system.

trigger.raw_text: The MSIU Field Office User receives a completed manual claim form with voucher slip and thumb impression from the VSP staff and initiates entry of the claim into the system.

claims.content: The system automatically generates the Claim number with Hospital Code as Suffix + 8 digit.
The user enters the Treatment Form No (List Form No from Claim receipt details which all are not yet entered in claim).
The user enters master level information including Syndrome, Clinical Examination, Diagnosis, Lab Test, Drugs Name – Frequency –No of days - Qty, and Other measure.
If applicable, the user enters information for First Follow UP (Diagnosis, Drugs Name – Frequency –No of days - Qty) or Second Follow UP (Diagnosis, Drugs Name – Frequency –No of days - Qty).
The system validates every information during claim entry against the MSIU treatment master and mandatory requirements.
The system accepts the claim only if the mandatory information is complete.

If the user enters incorrect Voucher No, the system may fail to automatically populate dependent fields such as Client Details, Syndrome treated, Lab Test Details, Drugs Details, Success of Treatment, Referral To Treatment, and Partner Treated.
If the user alters any information about treatment which is populating from the system based on Voucher No, it violates the system assumption that users will not alter auto-populated data.
If mandatory master level information (Syndrome, Clinical Examination, Diagnosis, Lab Test, Drugs, Other Measures) is incomplete during entry, the system will not accept the claim.
Claims with conspicuous or irregular data will be flagged for investigation and cleared by the VMU rather than being reimbursed immediately via bank transfer.
If the mandatory information is not complete during claim entry, the system will reject the claim and will not accept it.

If the user enters an incorrect Voucher No, the system may fail to auto-populate required fields (Client Details, Syndrome treated, Lab Test Details, Drugs Details, Success of Treatment, Referral To Treatment, Partner Treated), potentially causing validation failure or incomplete claim submission.
If the user alters any treatment information that was auto-populated from the system based on Voucher No, this violates system assumptions and may trigger rejection or manual review.
The claim is successfully entered into the computer database with all mandatory master level information (Syndrome, Clinical Examination, Diagnosis, Lab Test, Drugs, Other Measures) complete.
A unique Claim number has been automatically generated by the system using the Hospital Code as Suffix + 8 digit format.
The Treatment Form No from the claim receipt details is recorded in the system for the claim.
All entered data has passed validation checks and plausibilisations against the MSIU treatment master.
The claim is marked as 'clean' and eligible for reimbursement via bank transfer, unless flagged as conspicuous for further investigation by the VMU.
